How to read this

A higher stat-per-WA ratio means 1 WA is worth more stat. The ratio describes a small change at your current totals.

For an actual item choice, use the comparison below: it includes the extra benefit of gaining both stats and WA.

Formula & assumptions

Average = (minimum + maximum) / 2. Mastery is entered as a decimal in the formula. For mixed swing/stab weapons, the selected attack pattern weights both ranges.

The stat-window range is rounded down to whole numbers. Upgrade calculations use unrounded averages and exclude monster defense, level penalties, accuracy, critical hits, elemental effects, damage caps and integer rounding. Identical skill multipliers cancel in the comparison. If an upgrade changes those effects, this result may differ from actual damage.

Compare upgrades

Enter net changes after replacing equipment. Negative values are supported. Both upgrades are compared independently against the active setup, including selected MW and WA buff. Stat changes represent equipment stats (MW does not multiply them). In manual mode, MW uses the separate Base stats for MW inputs; verify those values first. Base AP changes are not modeled here.

Based on the supplied Damage Dealt Calculations extract from Nise’s Formula Compilation. Some exceptions are explicitly v62-specific. This is a raw damage comparison, not a DPM simulator. Mage spell damage is outside this WA calculator.
